attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry enumerates no member, so it is one folder for the company and not five, per the corpus's rule that a heading which names nobody is one entry. The corpus keeps no company of five martyrs of Nicomedia; its `clergy-martyrs-of-nicomedia-370` and its many single martyrs of Nicomedia are other entries on other days. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
